description:
Returns the published explanation of one HireGPS resume risk, looked up by name. Risks with their own page on hiregps.app return that page's full text; the others return the rule's severity and scoring category from the rule catalog. Every answer includes the source page.
Example input: {"risk": "Employment Gap"}

risk.description: The risk name, for example Employment Gap or Chronic Short Tenure.
risk.title: Risk

name: explain_resume_risk
title: Explain a resume risk
